title: ACE-Align: Attribute Causal Effect Alignment for Cultural Values under Varying Persona Granularities

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with diverse human cultural values by comparing predicted opinion distributions to standardized sociological survey data (WVS, ISSP) across 14 countries.

Measuring the causal effect of intersecting demographic attributes (gender, education, residence, and marital status) on model outputs using counterfactual persona edits, and comparing these shifts to empirical survey data to diagnose stereotyping and erasure.
Assessing the performance gap and geographic equity of models across countries categorized into different geocultural and economic resource tiers (e.g., Western vs. African countries).
